dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Slightly concave trailing edge following a smooth spline from the dorsal ridge to the apex.

dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width is approximately 1.4 times the vertical pixel height.
